_comment: Localised UI strings, flat key -> text. `{name}` placeholders are filled by UiText.t(). One file per locale; a missing key falls back to en. The tournament keys describe a FORMAT, not a tournament: the card adds the season's numbers.
tournament.league.single: Every club plays every other club twice, home and away.
tournament.league.split: One table first, then a split: the top half plays for the title, the bottom half for survival. Points carry over.
tournament.league.apertura: Two championships in one year — Apertura and Clausura — each with its own table and its own champion.
tournament.league.zones: The clubs are drawn into zones; the zone winners move on to the final stage.
tournament.cup.knockout: A knockout: lose and you are out.
tournament.super_cup.match: One match between the two clubs that won last season's trophies.
tournament.super_cup.mini: A four-club mini-tournament: two semi-finals and a final.
tournament.continental.league_phase: All {clubs} clubs share one table and play {rounds} matches each. The top {direct} go straight to the round of 16; the next {playoff} play an extra round.
tournament.continental.groups: Clubs are drawn into {groups} groups of {size}; the best {advance} in each group move on to the knockout rounds.
tournament.continental.knockout: A two-match knockout all the way to a single final.
tournament.clause.two_legged_rounds: The {rounds} are played over two matches — both scores are added up.
tournament.clause.two_legged_final: The final is also played over two matches.
tournament.clause.neutral_venue: The final is played at a neutral venue.
tournament.clause.one_playoff_place: One place is decided by a play-off.
tournament.clause.playoff_places: Some places are decided by a play-off.
tournament.league.zones_table: The clubs play in geographical zones; one combined table ranks every club.
